verdict.rationale: Synthesia's API docs cover the core loop an agent needs. The Video API generates videos from scripts or templates, and the quickstart describes polling or a completion webhook to watch the job. Finished videos come back with a time-limited `.mp4` download link, and a machine-readable llms.txt makes the docs agent-discoverable. Cost reporting is the weakest step: the Billing API exposes only the workspace's billing period and credit balance, with no per-job cost. Missing for 10: per-video cost or credit-consumption data on the job response, independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent completing the loop, detail on polling status fields.
